lead.label: 1 (7-methoxy-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrobenzo[f][1,4]thiazepine)
lead.why: Abstract: 'We report an efficient and scalable synthesis of 7-methoxy-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrobenzo[1,4]thiazepine ... proceeding via acyliminum cyclization, gives the target product in four steps and 68% overall yield'; the process paper's target API building block and model product.

reactions.conditions: K2CO3 (1.6 equiv), N,N-diisopropylethylamine (0.07 equiv), anhydrous THF, reflux under argon, 16 h; acid/base extraction. 95% yield.
reactions.source: Experimental section, '2-(4-Methoxyphenylthio)ethanamine (2)'; text says 4-methoxythiophenol is commercially available

reactions.conditions: NaHCO3 (1.5 equiv), water/DCM, 0 C then rt, 2 h. 89% yield.
p-TsOH (0.3 equiv), paraformaldehyde (10 equiv, added in 5 portions over 5 h), toluene, 70 C, 16 h; N-acyliminium (Pictet-Spengler type) cyclization. 84% yield.
33% HBr in acetic acid, DCM, rt, 1 h; Cbz removal; isolated as the hydrobromide salt (96%). Free base written as the target.

notes: Target is isolated as the HBr salt; the free base is the compared structure. Names of 2 and 4a are as printed in the Experimental headings; 5a and the target names are the printed headings (target without 'hydrobromide'). 2-Chloroethylamine is supplied as the hydrochloride (written as free amine). Atom balance for step 3 checked: C17H19NO3S + CH2O -> C18H19NO3S + H2O (HRMS [M+H]+ C18H20NO3S found). The paper's own count is 4 steps and 68% overall (95 x 89 x 84 x 96 = 68%), matching this transcription.
